sources.title: GDPR Art. 22 — automated decisions
sources.why: Directly grants users the right not to be subject to solely automated decisions and to obtain human intervention.

sources.title: EU AI Act — transparency obligations (Art. 50)
sources.why: Users must know when they interact with AI, enabling informed and autonomous decisions about its output.

sources.title: Telehealth — national health codes
sources.why: Keeps a human clinician as the decision-maker, preserving the patient's right to a real medical decision rather than the app's.
